download_fgvc_aircraft: download the FGVC Aircraft dataset archives and extract them to the specified root directory
create_fgvc_aircrafts_disk_folder: create a classification dataset folder with trainval, train, val, and test splits organized by aircraft label
create_fgvc_aircrafts_split: copy images from the source folder into label subdirectories based on a split labels file
read_label_list: read aircraft variant names from variants.txt and return them as normalized label strings
get_argument_parser: get an argparse argument parser supporting input path, output path, and download flag for the FGVC Aircraft script
